examples.title: Dry stroke / left
examples.description: Fresh physical contact on the generic left plate; the opposite channel is transmitted through the modeled fixture.

examples.title: Viscous film / left
examples.description: The same stroke with an idealized Newtonian film. This models viscous force and loss; it is not validated wet ASMR.

examples.title: Tap / right
examples.description: A single prescribed tool indentation drives the right plate, followed by physical decay.

examples.title: Measured KU100 receiver
examples.description: A synthesized vent source through measured horizontal KU100 responses at 0.5 m, 90 degrees. Absolute level is uncalibrated.

examples.title: Press and release
examples.description: A smooth normal engagement without texture sliding; compare its force and chamber pressure against the stroke.
